users.not-found: The requested user was not found.
users.restored: User restored. Their sessions stay signed out.
users.not-reaper-deleted: Only an account the inactivity reaper deleted can be erased by it.
users.not-warned: This account was never warned about its inactivity, so the reaper cannot delete it.
users.inactive-staff-account: An account that holds a staff role is never deleted by the inactivity reaper.
users.role-not-assignable: This role does not exist or cannot be given to an account.
users.purchase-hold-set: Purchase hold set. Checkout stays closed to this account until the date given, or until it is lifted.
users.purchase-hold-until-past: The end date must be in the future.

purchase-hold.subject: Checkout is paused on your account
purchase-hold.title: Checkout is paused on your account
purchase-hold.summary: We have paused new orders on your account until {{date}}.
purchase-hold.reason-repeated_cancellations: Why: {{count}} of your orders were cancelled by you within {{days}} days, and a rule pauses checkout after that. It was applied automatically.
purchase-hold.reason-staff: Why: a member of our team paused it.
purchase-hold.still-works: Paying an order you already placed, cancelling, withdrawing, returning goods and your own data rights are not affected.
purchase-hold.contact-intro: If you think this is a mistake, or you want to tell us your side, a person will read it.
purchase-hold.contact-label: Write to us about this pause
purchase-hold.objection: We apply this pause because we have a legitimate interest in keeping checkout from being abused. You may object to it at any time (GDPR Article 21): say so in your message and give your reason. You may also complain to your data protection authority (Article 77).
